Democracy Defender Mod Manager (DDMM), release candidate 17: *your mods, your democracy, defended.* It's still an
early build, but it's meant to be usable by anyone, not just developers.

**The DDMM Promise, in brief:** every mod is welcome (DDMM never blocks, blacklists or ranks mods or mod sites),
no account is ever needed on any site, your files stay in a folder you control, it's Apache-2.0 open source
forever, and update checks never run unless you ask.

## Quick start

1. **Download** the right file for you (see the table below).
2. **Run it.** DDMM looks for your Helldivers 2 install automatically. If Steam is in its usual place, there's
   nothing to set up.
3. **Add mods and click Deploy.** Drag in an archive or folder, or click "Add URL" and paste a link.

**Works with AyakaMods, Nexus Mods, ModWorkshop, GameBanana, GitHub, any direct link, or files already on your
disk.** Special love to the AyakaMods community ❤️, one of the best homes for Helldivers 2 modding. Go say hi:
<https://ayakamods.com/games/helldivers-2.119/>.

## Which file do I download?

| You want... | Download |
| --- | --- |
| A normal install on Windows (Start Menu shortcut, uninstaller) | `DDMM-2.0.0-rc.17-windows-x64-setup.exe` |
| Windows without installing anything (unzip and run) | `DDMM-2.0.0-rc.17-windows-x64-portable.zip` |
| Linux: Fedora, Nobara, openSUSE (`dnf`/`zypper`) | `DDMM-2.0.0-rc.17-linux-x86_64.rpm` |
| Linux: Debian, Ubuntu, Mint (`apt`) | `DDMM-2.0.0-rc.17-linux-amd64.deb` |
| Linux: other distros, no install (uses your desktop's graphics libraries) | `DDMM-2.0.0-rc.17-linux-x86_64.AppImage` |
| Linux: Arch/CachyOS, or just the binary (needs WebKitGTK 4.1) | `DDMM-2.0.0-rc.17-linux-x64.tar.gz` |

Linux install commands, the dependencies for each distro, and fixes for a blank window or AppImage/FUSE errors
are in [Installing on Linux](https://katsyk.github.io/DemocracyDefenderModManager/getting-started/linux/).

**One-click install (optional):** also grab the browser extension: `ddmm-extension-chrome-1.0.1.zip`
(Chrome, Edge, Brave) or `ddmm-extension-firefox-1.0.1.zip` (Firefox). See
[One-click install](https://katsyk.github.io/DemocracyDefenderModManager/using/one-click-install/).

Check `SHA256SUMS.txt` if you want to verify your download.

## What's new in 2.0.0-rc.17

### Security update

**Archive extraction**

- **DDMM now extracts .zip files with its own code.** It never creates links and never keeps the permission bits
  stored in an archive.
- **Fixed: extracted files could keep unsafe permissions.** Before, on Linux (and macOS), a zip or RAR made on
  Linux could leave an extracted mod file setuid or world-writable. The risk was low because nothing runs those
  files, but it's fixed. Windows wasn't affected.
- **Archives that would unpack to more than 16 GiB or more than 100,000 files are refused.** This protects
  against "zip bombs".
- **File and folder names Windows can't use are now refused on every platform:** names with a `:`, names ending
  in a dot or a space, and reserved names like CON, NUL, AUX, PRN, COM1 or LPT1. The message asks you to have the
  mod's author rename the file and upload it again.

**Secure connections**

- Updated the TLS library (rustls) and its certificate checker for the recent advisories. On Linux, DDMM could
  have trusted a certificate from some emSign intermediate CAs whose private keys are now public (if your system
  still trusts their root), and on any platform an attacker on your network could drop the post-quantum part of
  later connections (no keys exposed, and sites were still verified). Both are fixed.

**Nothing else changes for you.** Real mod files such as `.patch_0`, `.gpu_resources` and `.stream` are
unaffected.

### If you're coming from rc.14 or earlier

If you used the Skip List with rc.14 or earlier, verify the game files in Steam once (Library → Helldivers 2 →
Properties → Installed Files → Verify integrity of game files). Older versions could delete the game's own files
for those names.

**Skipped a few?** rc.10 had important safety fixes, rc.11 fixed mod deletion, rc.12 fixed mod option dropdowns, rc.13 fixed AyakaMods update checks, rc.14 fixed the Mods page stuck on "Loading...", rc.15 fixed Deploy and Purge removing mods and game files and rc.16 added Replace for mods with the same ID; see the [releases page](https://github.com/katsyk/DemocracyDefenderModManager/releases).

Thanks to everyone testing the release candidates. o7

## Known limitations

- **Windows builds are unsigned.** Windows SmartScreen will likely show a warning the first time you run the
  installer or the app. Click **"More info" → "Run anyway"** to continue.
- **The Linux .rpm and .deb are unsigned**, so openSUSE needs `zypper install --allow-unsigned-rpm`.
- **This is still a release candidate.** Expect some rough edges, and please report what you find.
